info.name: ZEDEDA App Profiles Service AppProfileService API

description.content:
The ZEDEDA App Profiles Service is part of ZEDEDA Edge Orchestration Platform. This service enables customers to define their app profiles on ZEDEDA platform and to manage them remotely.
